en: Hover a line for details. C - close
Raw power and toughness. More health, harder hits that push enemies farther, less damage taken and more carry weight.
Speed and reflexes. You attack and move faster, and enemies miss you more often.
Endurance. Sprinting and attacking tire you less.
Arcane power. Stronger spells, more mana and a bit more damage.
Locked: your magic has not awakened yet. It cannot be raised and gives no mana.
Sharp eyes. More critical hits, a wider light around you, more of the map revealed, and you spot monsters and traps from farther away.
Fortune. It does nothing yet; its effects come later.
Later: judging the value of items and learning spells.
